project_name: MyGenie Customer App - Search Mode Space Optimization Redesign
target_audience: Restaurant dine-in and takeout customers on mobile devices searching for specific dishes or drinks with active on-screen keyboard

brand_identity.theme: Light theme restaurant menu with high-contrast tactical food ordering clarity

core_design_problem.summary: In search mode on mobile (with virtual keyboard taking ~280px of 844px height), the app currently shows only 2 items compared to Swiggy showing 5 items. The filter chips row and generous top/bottom card paddings waste critical vertical space.
strict_constraints: Normal browse mode (when searchQuery is empty) MUST NOT CHANGE at all.
Item card content MUST stay intact: veg indicator dot, dish name, price/APS, ADD button/quantity selector, customizable indicator, allergens/desc remain available.
Changes are SEARCH MODE ONLY (active when searchQuery.trim().length > 0).

current_search_mode_breakdown.search_and_filter_container: 92px total (search input + 40px veg/non-veg/egg filter chips + 8px gap)
current_search_mode_breakdown.category_header: Removed in search mode by BUG-002
current_search_mode_breakdown.item_card_padding: 12px top + 12px bottom (24px padding + ~66px content = ~90-100px total height per card)
current_search_mode_breakdown.items_visible: Only 2 items visible above keyboard boundary

optimized_search_mode_breakdown.search_bar_height: 52px (search input with active query e.g. 'Beer', filter chips row HIDDEN)
optimized_search_mode_breakdown.filter_chips_status: HIDDEN during search mode (saves 40px chips + 8px gaps = ~48px vertical space)
optimized_search_mode_breakdown.search_meta_banner: 32px ('18 results for "Beer" · Clear' with instant reset CTA)
optimized_search_mode_breakdown.item_card_padding: 7px top + 7px bottom (14px total padding) with compact 3px text gap = ~76-80px card height
optimized_search_mode_breakdown.items_visible: 5 items visible above keyboard indicator (matching Swiggy benchmark)

interactive_mockup_specification.component_title: Search Mode Space Optimization Comparison (Side-by-Side Phone Mockup & Live Interactive Simulator)
interactive_mockup_specification.target_viewports: Dual iPhone 14/15 frames (390px x 844px each) arranged side-by-side on desktop, or toggled on mobile viewports

visual_state.header: 70px Orange #E8622A Header with back arrow & restaurant name
visual_state.filter_chips: VISIBLE Veg / Non-Veg / Egg chips row (40px height + 8px padding)
visual_state.item_cards: 2 full items visible (Corona Extra, Budweiser Magnum) + cut-off top of 3rd item
visual_state.keyboard_drawer: 280px iOS Virtual Keyboard overlay at bottom showing space constraint

visual_state.search_bar: Search input with query 'Beer' with tighter padding
visual_state.filter_chips: HIDDEN (smoothly collapsed with display: none or search-active state)
visual_state.meta_banner: Compact meta banner: '18 results for "Beer" · Clear'
visual_state.item_cards: 5 items fully visible: 1. Corona Extra (₹380), 2. Budweiser Magnum (₹280), 3. Heineken Silver (₹320), 4. Bira 91 White (₹290), 5. Kingfisher Ultra (₹240)
visual_state.keyboard_drawer: Same 280px keyboard zone, but 5 full items visible above keyboard boundary

SearchAndFilterBar.rule: When searchQuery.trim() is truthy, add CSS class or condition to hide the veg-toggle-group and dietary-tags-row. In normal mode (searchQuery === ''), show veg-toggle-group and dietary tags row as normal.

MenuItem.rule: Accept isSearchMode prop or apply .menu-item--search-compact when rendered in search mode. Reduce padding to 7px top/bottom (14px total). Maintain veg dot, name, price, ADD button, category tag, and allergen/info icons intact.

MenuItems_page.rule: Pass isSearchMode={Boolean(searchQuery.trim())} to MenuItem cards rendered in the search results list.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Render the requested high-fidelity side-by-side phone mockup displaying the CURRENT search mode on the left and the OPTIMISED search mode on the right.

2. On the LEFT (Current): Show the 70px orange header, 60px search bar with 'Beer', visible 40px filter chips row with gaps, taller items (~90-100px), 2 items visible above the 280px keyboard indicator.

3. On the RIGHT (Optimised): Show the same 70px orange header, tighter search bar with 'Beer', filter chips row completely HIDDEN, 32px search meta banner ('18 results for "Beer" · Clear'), compact items with 7px top/bottom padding (~80px height), exactly 5 items visible above the 280px keyboard indicator.
4. Ensure normal browse mode (no search query) remains 100% unchanged.

5. Include interactive controls allowing reviewers to toggle keyboard visibility, adjust search queries (e.g. 'Beer', 'Burger', 'Paneer'), toggle between comparison view and direct live app view, and inspect pixel heights.
